title: Dao Debate at Miaoyu Nunnery
summary: As An Miaoyi's guest, Gu Feng debates the lotus and the rootless floating plant with her, and they discuss whether an Ancient Holy Body can rise without a great power behind it. A bell from Purple Mountain shakes everyone's hearts and seven or eight Holy Lords cross the void through the Ancient Road Altar. An Miaoyi hands Gu Feng a place in the Source Arts (stone-battle) tournament, which someone had asked her to pass on, and asks for the Immortal Enlightenment Gem if he finds it. She privately admits she would bet on the Holy Body breaking a thousand-year curse. The tournament has been rushed forward because the bell turned the Jiang and Yaoguang imitation extreme weapons to dust and killed over a hundred elders, and the families want divine materials to use against Wu Shi's power. Gu Feng beats Wu Ziming of the Five Elements Palace, who came at Yaoguang's invitation to expose him. Tuoba Chang wins his match by swapping stones with the Golden-Red Divine Hand, and the final is set as Gu Feng against Tuoba Chang.
events: An Miaoyi and Gu Feng debate the lotus and the Holy Body
The Purple Mountain bell rings and Holy Lords arrive via the Ancient Road Altar

Narration: the bell wiped out imitation extreme weapons and over a hundred elders
Tuoba Chang beats a Zhao-family source master by swapping stones
Final: Gu Feng against Tuoba Chang
cultivation: An Miaoyi is re-captioned at Dao Palace. The Holy Body's Dao Palace is said not to produce divine source.
